caption:
A bad review doesn't hurt you. Ignoring it does.

Most owners either go silent or fire back defensive. Both cost you the next customer who reads that thread before they call.

Use this four-line reply inside 24 hours:

1. Name the specific issue. Skip "sorry for your experience."
2. Apologize without an excuse. Cut "unfortunately" and "due to."
3. Give a direct way to reach you. A number, not "call the office."
4. Move the fix off the thread. "Call me at [number], I'll make this right."

The star rating gets someone to your profile. Your reply gets them to book.

Black Arrow's platform automates the review ask and threads every reply in one inbox. 14 days free, no card.
